# BOUN Archive

> A historical course catalog, scheduling archive, and quota analytics platform for Boğaziçi University.

BOUN Archive indexes historical and current course offerings, instructor teaching legacies, quota change timelines, and schedule assignments across all academic departments at Boğaziçi University.

## Core API Endpoints

- `GET /v1/search`: Full-text & faceted course search (via Meilisearch). Supports query params `q`, `term`, `dept`, `instructor`, `delivery_method`, `sort`, `limit`, `offset`.
- `GET /v1/courses/history/{course_code}`: Multi-semester historical timeline of offerings, instructors, credit/ECTS values, and room/slot assignments for a course code (e.g. `CMPE 150`).
- `GET /v1/courses/{course_code}/quota`: Real-time and historical quota polling snapshots (capacity, registered count, consent status).
- `GET /v1/courses/{course_code}/changes`: Changelog of delta modifications (schedule changes, instructor changes, room reallocations).
- `GET /v1/courses/{course_code}/schedule.ics`: RFC 5545 iCalendar feed for weekly recurring class schedules.
- `GET /v1/instructors`: Complete directory of active and historical faculty instructors.
- `GET /v1/instructors/{instructor_id}`: Instructor profile and unique ID mapping.
- `GET /v1/analytics/instructor/{instructor_id}/legacy`: Historical courses taught, terms active, and teaching footprint.
- `GET /v1/departments`: All academic departments with short code (`kisaadi`) and Turkish/English full names (`bolum`).
- `GET /v1/departments/{dept_code}/unique-courses`: Unique course codes offered historically by a department.
- `GET /v1/departments/{dept_code}/instructors`: Faculty members associated with a department.
- `GET /v1/terms`: All indexed academic terms in chronological order (e.g. `2026/2027-1`, `2025/2026-2`).
- `GET /v1/analytics/ghost-schedule/{term}`: Ghost room utilization and unassigned classroom capacities.
- `GET /v1/analytics/macro/departments-evolution`: Longitudinal course count evolution across departments over decades.
- `GET /v1/analytics/macro/scheduling-heatmap`: Aggregate slot distribution heatmaps across days and hours.
- `GET /v1/system/status`: Scraper freshness, last sync timestamps, and database health.

## Core Entities & Models

- **Course**: An academic course (e.g., `CMPE 150`, `MATH 101`). Unique code per department.
- **Course Offering**: An instance of a course taught in a specific `term_id` and `section` (e.g. `CMPE 150.01` in `2026/2027-1`).
- **Instructor**: Faculty or teaching staff member.
- **Department**: Academic unit identified by `dept_kisaadi` (e.g., `CMPE`, `MATH`, `PHYS`, `HIST`, `ECON`).
- **CourseSlot**: Scheduled class time slot with `day_code` (`M`, `T`, `W`, `Th`, `F`, `St`, `Su`), `slot_hour` (1 to 13), and `room_name`.
- **QuotaSnapshot**: Time-series snapshot of course capacity, filled seats, and consent requirements.

## Content Negotiation & Linked Data

Entities can be requested in JSON-LD format by passing `Accept: application/ld+json`.
- `GET /v1/courses/{course_code}` with `Accept: application/ld+json` returns Schema.org `Course` and `CourseInstance` graph.
- `GET /v1/instructors/{instructor_id}` with `Accept: application/ld+json` returns Schema.org `Person`.
- `GET /v1/departments` with `Accept: application/ld+json` returns Schema.org `EducationalOrganization` list.

## Full LLM Index
For the complete schemas, parameter definitions, and semantic graph specifications, see [llms-full.txt](https://archive.bogazici.app/llms-full.txt).
